title: Daily digest: SIR Voters Deletion Is To Secure 4th Ter | CJP holds Constitution Day rally in Nagp | Revanth Reddy claims farmer suicides dec | Telangana owes existence to BR Ambedkar:
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu / Telangana Today
bullets_en: SIR Voters Deletion Is To Secure 4th Term for BJP, Says Revanth.
CJP holds Constitution Day rally in Nagpur; Dipke targets Centre, ECI.
Revanth Reddy claims farmer suicides declined as report cites 68 deaths in Telangana.
Telangana owes existence to BR Ambedkar: KTR.
bullets_ur: SIR voters ko khatam karna BJP ke 4th term ko bachana hai, Revanth Reddy ka bayan.
CJP ne Nagpur mein Constitution Day rally ki, Dipke ka Centre aur ECI par waar.
Revanth Reddy ka dawa ke kisan khudkushiyan kam huin, report mein Telangana mein 68 amwaat ka zikr.
Telangana ka wajood BR Ambedkar ki wajah se hai: KTR.
